question: Can I add my new spouse or baby to the policy and still get some benefits right away?
expected_answer: Yes, you can get continuity benefit for waiting periods already served, including the first 30 days, specific illness, and pre-existing disease waiting periods.
answer: You can add your new spouse or baby to the policy within 120 days of marriage or birth [p.12]. When you add them, the Pre-existing Disease clause, exclusions, loading, and Waiting Periods will apply as if it's their first year on the policy [p.24]. However, if you've already served some waiting periods, you can get continuity benefit for those waiting periods for your new spouse or baby [p.12]. This means you might be able to get some benefits right away for your new spouse or baby, depending on what you've already served.
